status: pre-registered before any evaluation code or performance figure existed
hypothesis: A passive, equally weighted holding of every point-in-time eligible NIFTY 50, Nifty Next 50 and Nifty Bank ETF, rebalanced monthly from Rs 3,000 in whole units, tracks the NIFTY 50 TRI before costs; its shortfall after evidence-backed costs measures what costs, whole-unit rounding and cash drag take from a Rs 3,000 account.

development.use: data and mechanics checks only; the strategy has no parameters to tune

schedule: the first tradable session of each calendar month inside the evaluation window

sensitivity.name: ex-post-liquidity (uses same-day information; never a headline result)

benchmarks.name: NIFTY 50 TRI
benchmarks.requires: official file imported, validated and covering the evaluation window

benchmarks.name: cost-matched NIFTYBEES buy-and-hold
benchmarks.requires: NIFTYBEES identity, corporate actions, distributions and costs verified; bought on the first decision date and held

benchmarks.name: uninvested cash
benchmarks.requires: nothing: zero return by construction (cash earns nothing in this simulation); a control, not a market benchmark

metrics: start and end value; return net of known costs (labelled when any fee is unresolved); CAGR only over at least 365 days; maximum drawdown over mark dates; volatility only with at least 24 monthly returns; turnover; order counts by outcome; fees by component; time invested; stale and gap counts; benchmark-relative return and drawdown when comparable
pre_tax: investor-level taxes are reported as unresolved and never computed
